metadata.message:
fix(learn): make original C readback explicit to caller proof

Bind the existing legacy Trainer reference explicitly and call its original readback method by UFCS, preserving the missing-source refusal, snapshot and prior. Move the existing protected expression to that equivalent syntax and update stale QA to the private helper split and actual S/C read edges. Preserve all boundary permissions, verifier bytes, owned-self and unregistered-caller attacks. All 16 observed failures are reproduced and repaired in the scoped 66-test regression; complete gates remain pending.

metadata.message:
test(hepta-agentd): repair original evaluation fixtures and capture native failures

Preserve original signature expiry semantics and complete unsorted Candidate admission. Split complete provider scenarios across bounded native cases without dropping owner reads or refusal assertions. Place three common Panel child futures on the heap without increasing the original 8 MiB stack.

Capture the original C evidence error and peer result, and add flushed stage markers to the deep S/C cold-readback test. These last two changes diagnose failures; they do not claim those failures or ordinary qualification are resolved.

All seven complete postimages were formatted by the actual Rust 1.96 toolchain and independently checked against the exact parent blobs. Native validation remains pending; ordinary Adopt, evaluated NoUpdate, daemon plus Root cold recovery and multigeneration remain zero.

docs(qualification): preserve cc22 native failures and exact repair provenance

Add the separately frozen 161-file evidence package with complete failed native log and JUnit, original GDB observations, scoped caller proof, withdrawn provider v1 and corrected v2, exact seven-file formatting and published repair identities. Preserve every original failure and distinguish original files from derived records and unrecovered references.

This package was frozen before new native validation and retains its prepublication metadata. The 4ab repair is native-unverified; all ordinary qualification counts remain zero. No product files or either earlier frozen evidence package are modified.

feat(hepta-agentd): add evaluated original-task reads for Selector

Keep the legacy TrainingNoUpdate profile strict. Add a separately bound four/five-cut readonly profile from actual opaque T/B and S receipts, and consume its real Source/Cell readback in the original remote Selector journal/signature path. Preserve live T/B readback, cancellation, original transport bounds and cold read-only behavior.

Add six mechanism cases and exact caller/source closure. Actual isolated Rust 1.96 formatting and 82 scoped source/mutation checks pass. These new native cases are unrun. The three-case native diagnostic runs separately on 4ab34bb; its result is not a validation of this source. Candidate/Root/Version dispatch and ordinary qualifications remain gated.

scope: Read-only metadata. Native object presence and any transfer are not asserted.
